readerCopy.body: The old coping mechanism may work quickly and still leave you in the same emotional place. The Moon square the South Node can make a familiar response collide with what the day actually requires. You may withdraw, over-accommodate, seek reassurance, or fall into a family role before you have decided that is what you want. The feeling itself deserves attention, but the first reaction may be history moving faster than judgment. Give the present situation a chance to be different before repeating the old answer.
